# KiLN

> KiLN is an operating system for a university innovation hub. It holds cohorts, ventures, milestones with evidence, a
> double-entry ledger, grants and staff roles in one system of record, and produces the donor reporting hubs assemble
> by hand. A venture of Coldcode SI Labs, Harare, Zimbabwe.

## What it is

KiLN tracks who is in a hub, what they are building, what they have proved, where the money went and which grant paid
for it. It replaces a spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group and a monthly scramble before a donor call.

Eight areas share one record: hub operations, ventures, people, finance, governance, grants, marketing and
infrastructure. The ledger is double-entry, so a grant can be followed from award to receipt line by line.

## Who it is for

University innovation hubs, incubators and TVET centres that run cohorts, hold grants and report to donors — the
programme manager, the finance officer, the grant manager and the director who signs the report.

## Price

- KiLN Starter — $99 per month. One hub, one programme, up to 20 ventures, impact dashboard, PDF reports.
- KiLN Growth — $299 per month. Unlimited programmes and cohorts, finance and grant management, donor reporting.
- KiLN Institutional — $799 per month. Multi-campus, API access, white-label, single sign-on.
- KiLN Implementation — $1,500–3,000 one-off. Migration from spreadsheets and WhatsApp, training, configuration.

Prices are in USD. There is no checkout URL because the storefront is not open: KiLN is at pilot stage.

## Two delivery models

- **KiLN Cloud** — a licence key and a URL, one database per hub on Cloudflare, browser client with offline cache.
- **KiLN Node** — an appliance image for a campus mini-PC. The university owns it and can air-gap it.

They are the same system delivered two ways, not two products.

## Status

Pilot stage. The product is specified and priced; the first deployment is a pilot with one hub, and checkouts open when
that pilot is agreed.
